items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: Albert Morgan was playing baseball with us. Him and I were taking a vacation with Chicago.

ctx.x: We used to play so much to attend the troops. Send somebody in our place sometimes.
Albert Morgan was playing baseball with us. Him and I were taking a vacation with Chicago. Just got tired of it. We stayed in Chicago a week. And come back. After we done got about broke. stuff
